project.name: Syston Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 15 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 33 of 34 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Syston qualifies as a local detour through Syston Lake Nature Spot and CHURCH OF SAINTS PETER AND PAUL. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Syston: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Syston offers Syston Lake Nature Spot, CHURCH OF SAINTS PETER AND PAUL, Syston Heritage Area within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Syston Lake Nature Spot
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Syston Lake Nature Spot and CHURCH OF SAINTS PETER AND PAUL, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: CHURCH OF SAINTS PETER AND PAUL
